doc: Scans the top nibble (bits 24-27, mask 0xFF000000 & (0x1000000<<i)) of D_800847D0.flags2 -- the per-channel "locked" flags -- for i in 0..3. On the first set bit, calls func_80055D84(i) to release/reactivate that channel (which sets the corresponding bit in D_800847D0.flags1's "avail" range), then clears the located bit in flags2 and returns. If no bit is set in any of the 4 slots, returns without calling anything.
